newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian bonds slumber, wait for direction.
newsitem.headline: Australian bonds slumber, wait for direction.

text.p: *Australian bonds remain quiet to midday, at levels slightly below Monday's closes, as market waits on U.S. FOMC decision later today. Market fairly evenly split on rates outlook.
*Locals also waiting on key wages data later this week.
Australian bonds were almost stationary through the morning session as the market waited on the outcome of the U.S. FOMC meeting later today and key local wages data on Wednesday and Thursday.

Morning trade was very slow -- less the 1,300 June 10-year bond futures had been traded, the last of those almost 40 minutes before noon. The trade that did occur saw bonds in narrow ranges around their slightly easier opening levels.
The market was waiting in the FOMC, and unlike the widely expected hike following the March meeting, analysts were split as to whether there would be a rate hike at this meeting.
